This indicates that Robustaside F may act through multiple pathways to influence CWR22R, potentially through different molecular mechanisms. The integration of these targets highlights the complexity of the relationship, with Robustaside F possibly exerting its effects via multiple molecular mediators that ultimately converge on CWR22R.
